title: fat_proc_dwi_to_dt
description: This program fits tensors and DT parameters, as well as the uncertainty of DT parameters needed for tractography.

in_gradmat.description: Input text file of N gradient vectors or bmatrices.
in_gradmat.title: Gradient Matrix

prefix.description: Set prefix for output DWI data.
prefix.title: Output prefix

in_bvals.description: Optional, if bvalue information is in a separate file from the b-vectors or matrices.
in_bvals.title: Bvals

mask.description: Optional whole brain mask can be input; otherwise, automasking is performed.
mask.title: Mask

mask_from_struc.description: Flag to make a mask using 3dSkullStrip+3dmask_tool from the structural file.
mask_from_struc.title: Mask from structural file

in_struc_res.description: Alignment of the output DWI to the REF data set via anatomical reference; a version of the anatomical that has been resampled to match the DWI set.
in_struc_res.title: Resampled anatomical reference

in_ref_orig.description: Use another data set to adjust the DWI and subsequent parameter dsets' orientation and origin.
in_ref_orig.title: Reference data set

prefix_dti.description: Set prefix for output DTI data; default is 'dt'. Do not include path information here.
prefix_dti.title: DTI Output prefix

flip_x.description: Flip the DW gradients in the x-direction.
flip_x.title: Flip x

flip_y.description: Flip the DW gradients in the y-direction.
flip_y.title: Flip y

flip_z.description: Flip the DW gradients in the z-direction.
flip_z.title: Flip z

no_flip.description: Do not flip the DW gradients.
no_flip.title: No flip

no_scale_out_1000.description: Turn off scaling of physical length units by 1000 for tensor fitting.
no_scale_out_1000.title: No scale out 1000

no_reweight.description: Turn off reweighting and refitting of tensors during estimation.
no_reweight.title: No reweight

no_cumulative_wts.description: Turn off displaying overall weight factors for each gradient.
no_cumulative_wts.title: No cumulative weights

qc_fa_thr.description: Set threshold for overlay FA volume in QC image.
qc_fa_thr.title: QC FA threshold

qc_fa_max.description: Set cbar max for overlay FA volume in QC image.
qc_fa_max.title: QC FA max

qc_fa_unc_max.description: Set cbar max for overlay uncertainty (stdev) of FA in QC image.
qc_fa_unc_max.title: QC FA uncertainty max

qc_v12_unc_max.description: Set cbar max for overlay uncertainty (stdev) of V1 towards V2 direction for DTs in QC image.
qc_v12_unc_max.title: QC V12 uncertainty max

qc_prefix.description: Set the prefix of the QC image files separately.
qc_prefix.title: QC Prefix

no_qc_view.description: Turn off generating QC image files.
no_qc_view.title: No QC View

no_cmd_out.description: Don't save the command line call of this program and the location where it was run.
no_cmd_out.title: No Command Output

workdir.description: Specify a working directory, which can be removed.
workdir.title: Working Directory

no_clean.description: Do not remove the working directory.
no_clean.title: No Clean

uncert_iters.description: Set the number of Monte Carlo iterations for the uncertainty calculation (default: 300).
uncert_iters.title: Uncertainty Iterations

uncert_extra_cmds.description: Extra commands for the uncertainty calculations.
uncert_extra_cmds.title: Uncertainty Extra Commands

check_abs_min.description: Help the program push through finding tiny negative values in columns that should contain numbers >=0. Provide a tolerance value VVV.
check_abs_min.title: Check Abs Min
